acl.createDescription: Creates an isolated network: machines in this fleet only see each other (and Stramatel support).
acl.rawDescription: For what the guided view does not cover. Always validated by Headscale before being applied.

rules.title: Who can reach whom
rules.description: Rules enforced by Headscale, from broadest to finest.
rules.support: <name>Stramatel support</name> (internal fleet) can reach <name>the whole park</name>.
rules.isolation: <name>Each fleet only sees its own machines</name> ({count, plural, =0 {no fleet} =1 {1 fleet} other {# fleets}}):
rules.noException: No exception: all customer fleets are isolated from each other.
rules.addDescription: One-way isolation exception: the source can reach the destination's machines, not the other way round.
rules.warning: Machines in “{from}” will be able to reach those in “{to}”. Isolation between these two fleets is lifted in that direction.
rules.warnNoSupport: Stramatel support no longer reaches the park: the “internal → all” rule is missing.
rules.warnNoIsolation: Fleet “{fleet}” has no isolation rule: its machines cannot reach each other.
rules.sshDescription: SSH sessions allowed through Tailscale SSH (read-only, editable in the advanced editor).
rules.ssh: <name>{from}</name> can open an SSH session ({users}) on <name>{to}</name>.
